noClient.title: Open League to start
noClient.text: Open League: Xyra sets your build in any mode and marks the best augment card.

client.title: All set. Let's play
client.text: Queue up: in champion select Xyra sets your build and shows your options, and in ARAM: Mayhem and Arena it marks the tier of each card.

paused.title: Xyra is paused
paused.text: It does not read the screen or draw anything. Resume whenever you want.

inGame: Watching your cards: the best one gets marked the moment they appear.
yourChampion: Your champion · rank #{{rank}} in ARAM: Mayhem.
riftChampion: Check its build and matchups before the game starts.
counterText: Wins {{value}} of its games against {{enemy}} in {{position}}.
noCards: When augment cards show up in ARAM: Mayhem or Arena they will appear here.
fullscreenWarning: League is in fullscreen: labels cannot be drawn over the game.
borderlessDone: Done: your next game opens in Borderless.
noOcr: Windows has no text recognition for your language: add it in Settings → Time & language.
followedNo: It was not the recommended one

orderHint.tier: The best in ARAM: Mayhem according to OP.GG. In champion select, the bench follows the same order.
orderHint.mastery: The ones you master most, by your mastery points. In champion select, the bench follows the same order.
orderHint.played: The ones you played most in the games Xyra stored. In champion select, the bench follows the same order.
orderHint.balanced: Best tier first and, within each tier, the ones you master most. In champion select, the bench follows the same order.

bestByPosition: Best of the patch by position

modeTopHint.aram: ARAM win rate from OP.GG. Tap one to see its build.
modeTopHint.arena: Top-four finishes from OP.GG. Tap one to see its augments.
